answer: Pay agents by leave-one-out marginal value, not headcount. Each epoch the ledger rescores the shared forecast ensemble with and without every seat and pays each only the accuracy it alone adds. A clone farm grazing one meadow of data submits near-identical forecasts: drop any one and the ensemble barely moves, so each earns almost nothing. Like a juniper hedge where pulling one shrub leaves no gap, redundant seats are hollow; only independent signal gets paid.
